name: @repo/agent-container
description: The agent image: the pi coding agent as a node process inside a per-user Cloudflare Sandbox, plus the daemon that materializes ./vault and reports every event, tool call and file write back to the user's UserHost Durable Object. src/protocol.ts is the pure wire contract the Worker half imports, beside src/vault-report.ts — what the object's answer to a vault report MEANS, which the scripted container reads the same way this daemon does. src/pi/* is this package's harness quarantine.
